# Haider Khursheed

> Founder and entrepreneur building consumer companies and AI-first software. Founder & Chairman of Lixta Network and founder of Home for Builders.

## Core Information
- **Name**: Haider Khursheed
- **Role**: Founder & Chairman of Lixta Network
- **Professional name**: Haider Khursheed
- **Legal name**: Abdul Rehman Khursheed Khan
- **Primary Ventures**:
  - **Lixta Network** (Founder & Chairman): A studio that builds brands, websites and apps and turns manual work into AI-first software. Founded with Abdullah Yasin Shaikh. (URL: https://lixtanetwork.com)
  - **Home for Builders** (Founder): A community for developers, designers, and internet builders. (URL: https://homeforbuilders.com)
  - **Komunity** (Co-Founder): An onchain hiring platform based on proof of work. It received early backing from an angel investor and reached 1,000+ users before shutting down in April 2026. (URL: https://komunity.dev)
  - **Game Development Studio**: Co-founded a small game development studio during his diploma. Exited and closed in 2023.
- **Website**: https://www.haiderkhursheed.com
- **Contact**: haider@lixtanetwork.com / haiderkhursheedk@gmail.com

## Featured Essays & Writing

- [Building in Public and the Art of Shipping](https://www.haiderkhursheed.com/writing/building-in-public-and-the-art-of-shipping): Why rapid execution beats theoretical planning.
- [What Failing Taught Me About Product Distribution](https://www.haiderkhursheed.com/writing/what-failing-taught-me-about-product-distribution): Lessons from building Komunity.
